title: Kutainese language explained
text: There are three principal dialects of Kutai Malay language; all three have partial mutual intelligibility with each other due to the geographical proximity of these dialects. The three main dialects are Tenggarong (vkt), Kota Bangun (mqg), and Ancalong (currently does not have its own ISO 639-3 code).

title: Malay, Kota Bangun Kutai Language (MQG) - Ethnologue
text: Kota Bangun Kutai Malay is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family and is part of the Malay macrolanguage.
